claim_boundary: Exact-arithmetic storage-policy equivalence and measured classical process costs on five fixed FCIDUMPs, full candidate pools and frozen stopping rules. Fresh workers isolate allocator history. RSS includes preparation, reference, support history, scalar caches, instrumentation and coefficient rows; it is not an attributed coefficient-storage byte count. Packed live/reserved bytes and 24-byte coefficient payload estimates are separate. No sampling, hardware-time price, universal memory bound or quantum advantage is established. Historical records and the object default remain unchanged.
